subject: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)
body:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 10 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)

Team,

Requesting approval to open five Q3 GTM reqs tied to new ARR targets and expansion into the mid-market segment. Summary below — full plan attached (headcount_plan_Q3.xlsx) and comp bands (comp_bands_2025.pdf).

High-level ask
- 3 Account Executives (2 AE-IC, 1 Senior AE) — US-based, remote/hybrid
- 2 Solutions Engineers (1 Mid, 1 Senior) — prioritize west coast / central timezone
- Total new FTEs: 5; planned start window: Aug–Oct 2025

Cost & comp guidance
- Estimated first-year fully loaded run rate: ~$1.2M (salaries + benefits + hiring costs)
- Comp bands per attachment; Senior AE OTE band: $240k–$300k; Standard AE OTE: $140k–$200k
- Initial headcount IDs (please see sheet): HC-2025-GTM-17 to HC-2025-GTM-21

Rationale
- Sales plan increase: add quota-carrying coverage to support ARR target + new enterprise segment motion; SE hires to support complex POCs and shorten sales cycle for targeted accounts.

Compliance & approvals needed
- Finance approval for budget (Dev)
- Final comp signoff and equity guidance (Monica)
- Headcount signoff from Markus

Next steps requested by Jul 17: reply with approvals or comments. If approved, I will open reqs in Greenhouse and loop in Tracy (Greenlight Recruiting) to begin candidate outreach.

Thanks,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Director, Go-to-Market Strategy
Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Jul 2025 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)

Tessa —

Thanks for the concise plan. I approve the headcount in principle but want clarity on two items before final sign-off:
1) Senior AE comp: can the Senior AE OTE exceed $280k in exceptional circumstances (top-of-band candidate with existing book)?
2) Approval flow for a Director-level IC (if a candidate asks for title bump) — do we require an additional exec sign-off?

Also, please include a short success metric for each role (ramp quota by month 6, expected pipeline contribution).

Markus
VP Sales

-----Original Message-----
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:05:44 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)

Adding the updated headcount tab (I pasted a quick run-rate) — see headcount_plan_Q3.xlsx (tab: "run_rates"). Notes:
- We have 2 hiring credits available from earlier offer falls; net new reqs = 3 (we can reallocate if needed)
- Pipeline velocity assumptions built into the plan (conservative)

Questions:
- Do we want to distribute AEs across East/West or cluster by region? Clustering helps SE pairing but risks coverage gaps.

Sean — can you confirm interview loop and expected time-to-offer per req?

Grace
Head of Revenue Operations

-----Original Message-----
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 10:18:29 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)

Team —

Finance can approve the incremental hiring under the revised quota-based headcount envelope, subject to the following conditions:
- Senior AE OTE must be capped at $290k unless exec approval is provided and a business case is submitted (if candidate demands >$290k).
- Total FY25 incremental hiring spend across GTM must remain <= $3.6M; this cohort fits within that limit by our estimates.
- Please route PO and offer letter templates through FinanceOps (finops@redwood.ai) before extending offers.

I'll mark this as conditionally approved; send me the consolidated run-rate and I will finalize the budget entry.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Finance Director, Revenue Finance

-----Original Message-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 12:32:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)

Thanks for the plan. A few HR items to confirm before we open reqs:
- Equity guidance: new Senior AE should be offered 0.06%–0.10% depending on experience; Mid SE 0.03%–0.05%.
- Title leveling: follow our standard leveling doc (see eq_guidelines_2025.pdf). If a candidate requests Director level, we will review on a case-by-case basis and may require additional approvals from People + Markus.
- I will create the Greenhouse reqs once comp bands and job descriptions are finalized. Please send JD drafts to jobs@redwood.ai.

Monica Patel
Senior Talent Partner, People Ops

-----Original Message-----
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Tracy Green <tracy@greenlight-recruiting.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)

Thanks all — consolidating approvals and next steps below: 

Decisions made:
- Headcount approved in principle (Markus)
- Finance conditional approval with $290k cap for Senior AE OTE (Dev)
- Equity and leveling guidance accepted (Monica)
- Ops will allocate 2 hiring credits to speed earliest reqs (Grace)

Immediate next steps (owner in parens):
- Update headcount_plan_Q3.xlsx with final run-rate and send to Dev for budget entry (Grace)
- Finalize comp band for Senior AE at $280–$290k and publish to Greenhouse (Monica)
- Job descriptions to jobs@redwood.ai by EOD Wed (Tessa)
- Engage Greenlight Recruiting to start outreach for first two reqs (Tracy)
- Weekly hiring sync on Fridays, 10am PT — invite to follow (Sean)

Tracy: please find attached the headcount plan and comp bands. Start with resume sourcing for two IC AE roles and one Mid SE. We expect first candidate shortlist by Jul 31.

Attachments: headcount_plan_Q3.xlsx, comp_bands_2025.pdf

If anything materially changes I will update the thread; otherwise I'll open the reqs in Greenhouse once JD drafts are in.

Best,
Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Director, Go-to-Market Strategy
Redwood Inference

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Tracy Green <tracy@greenlight-recruiting.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 16:10:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Approve Q3 GTM hires: 3 AEs + 2 Solutions Engineers (comp bands & headcount)

Tessa —

Appreciate the context. We'll queue searches for: 2 AE ICs (mid-market, cloud SaaS), 1 Mid SE (technical demos + integrations). ETA for candidate slates: 2–3 weeks from req kick-off.

Quick notes on market comp: we are seeing mid-market AEs in the West coast at OTEs ranging $160k–$220k; Senior AE demand is competitive and will often request >$300k OTE in some cases. We'll prioritize candidates within your capped bands and flag exceptions early.

I'll expect your JD drafts and will sync with Sean on the interview loop.

Tracy Green
Principal Recruiter
Greenlight Recruiting
